summary: Round 2 retrofit clears the bar. E2.1 fully addressed with Day-2 forward bridge. Trap is research-grounded with Sarama & Clements (2009) and Lehrer (2003) cited; recovery_moves branches by 3 diagnostics (A/B/C). Puppets explicitly OPTIONAL; NO-MATERIALS PATH (hand-span/footstep/finger-width) named in differentiation. Roo refrain 'SMALL unit, BIG count — BIG unit, small count!' chanted 3x. PREDICT-THEN-MEASURE step lets children invent strategy. Worksheet Part 3 transfer-task varies format from lesson.
